name: STIHL MS 271
blurb: 16″, 18″ and 20″ bars on .325″ chain, .063″ gauge, 67–81 drive links, per STIHL's chain-selection chart.
intro: The STIHL MS 271 appears in STIHL's saw-chain selection chart with 16″, 18″ and 20″ guide bars: the same .325″ pitch, .063″ gauge chain family as the MS 261 and MS 291, in 67, 74 and 81 links. Sharpening that loop is not one published diameter. STIHL sells 11/64″ and 3/16″ files for .325″ chain; Oregon specifies 3/16″. Both are listed on each row.

bars.note: STIHL's chart lists chain 26 RM3 67 with recommended bar 3003 810 7113.
STIHL's chart lists chain 26 RM3 74 with recommended bar 3003 810 7117.
STIHL's chart lists chain 26 RM3 81 with recommended bar 3003 810 7121.

sources.title: Saw Chain Selection and Identification (STIHL USA catalog page 173; specifications as of 1 October 2017): recommended chain loop and guide bar per saw model

STIHL 2025 Full Line catalog, file table (catalog p. 167): .325″ round files in 4.5 mm (11/64″, part 7010 871 0402) and 4.8 mm (3/16″, part 7010 871 0403). The table does not assign one size to a loop.
Saw Chain Filing Angles chart (2020): 3/16″ round file for .325″ chain (types 95VPX, 95TXL, and 20, 21, 22 BPX and LPX)

sources_note: STIHL USA “Saw Chain Selection and Identification” chart (catalog page 173, specifications as of 1 October 2017), read on 24 Oct 2026. Bar rows stay on that 2017 reading. File diameters: STIHL 2025 Full Line catalog p. 167 lists 4.5 mm (11/64″) and 4.8 mm (3/16″) for .325″ without naming a loop, and Oregon’s 2020 Filing Angles chart lists 3/16″ for .325″ types 95, 20, 21 and 22. Both file sources read 3 Nov 2026.
